title: Bulgarian St. Stephen Church
axis: Positive Z points southwest through the public entrance. Positive X follows the front to the southeast. The apse faces the Golden Horn.
source: Named OpenStreetMap cast-iron church and its mapped main entrance.

features.role: Standing iron church, including the eastern apse
Mapped public entrance on the bell tower side

identityStatus: The named Istanbul footprint fixes the two long walls and the five-sided apse. The 1895 German trade journal records a 15 m width and a 30 m bell tower to the cross. The present mapped shell is about 15.2 m wide and 27 m long to the apse, so the model uses the actual mapped face locations.

terrainContact.basis: Unchanged source ground beneath the public entrance steps at the Golden Horn church.

notes: The July 1895 Stahl und Eisen photograph and full plate show the built ironwork in the Waagner works yard before shipment. The Orthodox Patriarchate and the municipal restoration team document the standing basilica, five-sided apse and zinc-coated sheet roof.
